title.narrative: Promote and implement ENGAGE TB through Civil Society to reduce barriers of access to TB services for key populations in 8 countries of the LAC region - Americas - Multicountry TB LAC PIH (01-Jul-2019-30-Sep-2022)

description.narrative: Multicountry TB LAC PIH, Tuberculosis, Partners In Health (PIH)This program has the following goals: Empower TB civil society in LAC to assist in the comprehensive response against tuberculosis, with a focus on human rights, gender equality and focusing on key populations.. The objectives of this program are: Consolidate the ENGAGE TB approach in 8 LAC countries for the integration of community-based TB activities into the work of civil society organizations (CSOs).. Creation and expansion of 8 national social observatories to monitor the TB response, advocacy and resource mobilization (including financial resources for CBOs activities), as well as capacity building of civil society for their participation and involvement in TB promotion, prevention, diagnosis and treatment.. Strengthening of monitoring and community surveillance systems for the effective reference and counter-referral of TB care in LAC migrants.
